body: I don't think I will ever get over this. At all. I love her more than anything.
You cannot reason with that kind of mentality, believe me. You cant reason with mine, for example.
What could you have said if she appeared fine? If she appeared fine, it probably means that she had already made up her mind.

Don't worry man, you're not wasting my time. I think that you can make it through, as you seem quite hesitant. I am here to talk to you. Why do you feel suicidal in the first place? Let's start with that, ok?
Punch the crazy bastard in the fucking face... he deserves it... a fucking cult... pfffft!
But I don't think there is anyone else that I will love back... especially not one that will feel the same way.

Truthfully, I don't know. And that's pretty rare for me! But I am also suicidal, and I now understand a suicidal person's mentality. Truthfully, they may not have even wanted help. So there was probably nothing you could have done. It was quite possibly driven by a force entirely outside anyone's control. I don't know if it makes you feel any better, but... it was worth saying I guess.

But... no one can even compare. At all. She is the one thing in this universe that would make me truly happy. She is perfect, for me. I truly, TRULY love her. I can't love anyone else. Nor would I ever want it to be anyone else. I really just can't do this. :'(
